text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Good morning! A crisp day begins with a booming greeting! Come on, smiles everyone! Good morning!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Also! Team Triathlon announced the other day! Class President Sakura Bakushin O will definitely participate!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Massive, massive teammate recruitment drive! Step right up if interested!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Good morning!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Yes, good morning! Love that spirited energy!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Bakushin O-san is entering the Triathlon too. With that loud call, she'll find four teammates in no time.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Alright, we should invite our classmates too...!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text: Ah... sorry. I don't think so... Swimming and biking really aren't my thing...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Then, how about running—

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text: Can't do running either. Don't you guys get it? Upperclassmen are entering this tournament too.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text: No way we beat seniors loaded with experience and training. Joining in just makes us fodder...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: You never know until you try. Outcomes aren't predetermined.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text: Maybe you two can put up a good fight. Count us out, but we'll cheer for you! Good luck!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Look, Narita Top Road-san is over there~. Everyone's talking about entering that Triathlon thing~.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Oho, must make haste! I require her on my team!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Looks like Opera O-san wants to scout Top Road-san for her squad.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Scout...?! Th-That's incredible...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Means she's recognized as strong enough. ...All those powerful seniors teaming up...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...Competing against upperclassmen didn't even cross my mind... Ehehe, totally slipped my head...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Kita-chan...

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl C
text_block_list.text: Hey Top Road, you're doing the Triathlon, right? Who're you teaming with? You'd carry any squad anyway!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl D
text_block_list.text: If Top Road enters, championship is locked in! Really looking forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Um... I haven't decided if I'm even entering yet. Honestly, it might be over my head—

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Pardon me! Top Road-san, a moment? Are you truly hesitating over whether to join the Triathlon?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ah, yes! That's right!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ah, how tragic! Can you not hear it? The roar of the multitude encircling you! A resounding hymn for one destined for glory!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: This grand commemorative stage demands your radiance! Would you turn your back on their fervent hopes?!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: —Yet, I know your noble soul. You are no cold-hearted spectator! Thus, take my hand and step onto the grand stage!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: ...... Opera O-chan, are you inviting me to your team?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Indeed! You are worthy to adorn the epic saga of the Overlord! I came prepared to extend this grand invitation!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Overlord saga... I see.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I'm honored! Please let me join your team, Opera O-chan! I will give it everything I have to meet everyone's expectations!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Magnificent! Together we shall ignite this banquet of champions! That makes me, Top Road-san, and Doto... only one spot remains!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh, what... Eeeeeeeh~?! W-Wait, I was already on the team~?!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I decline. ...Like I said before, I'm not interested.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Opera O is on your team, right? She already gave up trying to recruit me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Yes, so I heard. But Opera O-chan tried to sign your name onto the registry anyway—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: So I stopped her and came myself! After all, ignoring your own feelings would be completely wrong!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: —...Saved me there. Good grief...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Opera O must have roped you in. Even so... you're way too nice.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Opera O-chan's invitation sparked it, but joining was my own choice!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Opera O-chan told me everyone wanted to see me out there, so I should be on that podium—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: And I thought, yes, that's it! Making people happy by meeting their expectations fills me with joy. That's why I want to answer them!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Besides, she recognized my strength and reached out directly.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Even if Opera O-chan's way of talking is a little hard to follow sometimes!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...You really are something...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: —Fine. I'll enter.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Really?! Thank you so much, Ayabe-san!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Leave it alone and Opera O will just drag me around anyway... What a pain...
